body: Operator, 2026-11-05: they are half the point. v0 left both as claims: neither was installed or packaged on the host. d-wrapper stands, so they arrive unforked: zp as a derivation of the upstream release, pi-zmx as a pi package installed per home. Installing into ~/.pi and ~/agent_home/.pi is manual, because both settings.json files are plain mutable files.
notes: 2026-11-06: pi-zmx no longer unforked. Upstream reports a timeout as success and has been quiet for six months, so both homes pin the operator fork. See IMP-001.
title: zp and pi-zmx are in v0.1
